dct_description_sm:
This table of dwelling and households profile information for dissemination area was extracted from the Statistics Canada 2021 Beyond 20/20 browser software. It contains the information gathered during the 2021 Census with respect to the population within a dissemination area and the breakdown of this population by household composition and dwelling characteristics. This data covers the dissemination areas in York Region only.

Please exercise caution if using dissemination areas to roll up (aggregate) to other levels of census geographies, due to greater suppression applied by Statistics Canada at dissemination area.

Interested in viewing and interacting with this data even more? Visit the York Region Census Explorer Dashboard to gain high level insights from this data at the municipal and regional level for York Region.
